title: HTTP designer impact request (1.6)
description: The JSON body POSTed to /impact on an HTTP-bound designer's origin -- design/designer-interface.md §7.1, 'Impact'. Sent only to a designer whose /health reports "impact": true and the design identity the caller would redesign with. Unique ids are required but not expressible here: two records with one id are a 400.

records.description: at most 500; a library is sent in several requests, one after another

id.description: the caller's own key, unique within the request, echoed back

path.description: a design's run_record, sent back unchanged: POSIX-style, relative to the designer's shared root, never absolute, no backslash, no '..' segment. A path that is missing, unreadable or escapes the root is that record's unknown, never an error.
